title: Gunko Teases Her Abilities in One Piece Episode 1166 Preview Trailer
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1166, with the Knight of God Gunko giving a preview of her ability. The anime recently revealed a trailer for the Holy Knights of God , introducing their voice cast led by Kenjiro Tsuda as Shamrock.

title: Web Novel Series 'Got Dropped Into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work' Gets Webtoon Adaptation
content: Kakao Entertainment has announced that the web novel Got Dropped Into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work will be adapted into a webtoon, which debuted on Kakao Page on June 5. title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 Announces Opening Song Artists, October Debut
content: The official website for the anime based on Wookjakga 's A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ( Kikansha no Mahō wa Tokubetsu Desu in Japanese) Korean web comic unveiled on Sunday the opening theme song's artists, October premiere, and teaser visual for the anime's second season.

content: The official website for a television anime adaptation of Ringo Naki 's Otome Kaijuu Caraméliser ( Kaiju Girl Caramelise ) manga revealed additional staff, a second key visual (pictured above), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 3 at 1:28 a.m.

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 Premieres October 2026, FLOW Returns for Opening Theme
content: The second season of A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special has been confirmed to premiere in October 2026. A new teaser visual and PV trailer were also released alongside the announcement. Studio Arvo Animation is back to animate, with Taishi Kawaguchi returning as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kaiju Girl Caramelise Anime's New Video Unveils More Staff, Theme Songs, July 2 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Spica Aoki 's Kaiju Girl Caramelise ( Otome Kaijū Carameliser ) manga revealed its second main promotional video, second main visual, additional staff members, theme songs, and July 2 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Top 5 Anime Expo 2026 Reveals We’re Most Excited About
content: The Anime Expo event is one of the biggest events held in North America, and the 2026 edition is shaping up to be even more exciting. In recent years, the anime industry has become a major part of pop culture, with anime making waves and even challenging Hollywood.
author: ComicBook

title: Kaiju Girl Caramelise Reveals Second Main Visual, Trailer, Theme Songs, July 2 Premiere
content: The upcoming KAIJU GIRL CARAMELISE anime has released its second main visual and second trailer ahead of its July 2, 2026 premiere. The announcement also revealed the anime’s opening and ending theme songs. The anime was announced in December 2025, with studio LIDEN FILMS in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Reiwa no Dara-san' Reveals Additional Cast, Ending Theme, Second Promo
content: The official website for a television anime adaptation of Haruomi Tomotsuka 's Reiwa no Dara-san ( Dara-san of Reiwa ) manga revealed additional cast, the ending theme, and second promotional video on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 2 at 9:30 p.m.
